---
title: "Excitation-Inhibition Balance Tuning via tvboptim"
---

Reproducing the FIC+EIB tuning workflow from [Schirner et al. (2023)](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-38626-y). Fits local inhibitory weights (J_i) for E-I balance and dual coupling weights (wLRE, wFFI) to match empirical functional connectivity.

```{python}
# | output: false
import os

os.environ["XLA_FLAGS"] = "--xla_force_host_platform_device_count=8"

from tvbo import SimulationExperiment
from tvboptim.observations.observation import compute_fc, fc_corr, rmse
from matplotlib.colors import Normalize
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Load experiment (network + target FC loaded from BIDS automatically)
exp = SimulationExperiment.from_file(
    "/Users/leonmartin_bih/tools/tvbo/database/experiments/EI_Tuning_FIC_EIB_Optimization.yaml"
)
print(exp.render_code('tvboptim'))
```

```{python}
results = exp.run("tvboptim", mode="all")
```


## Results
```{python}
#| label: fig-ei-tuning-results
#| fig-cap: "**EI Tuning Results.** Row 1: FIC algorithm (local E-I balance). Row 2: FIC+EIB combined + EIB-post-FIC FC. Row 3: Gradient-based optimization with combined loss."
#| fig-height: 14

cmap = plt.cm.cividis
accent_blue = cmap(0.3)
accent_gold = cmap(0.85)
accent_mid = cmap(0.6)

mosaic = """
AABBCCDD
EEFFGGHH
IIJJKKLL
"""
fig, axes = plt.subplot_mosaic(mosaic, figsize=(16, 12))

# =============================================================================
# ROW 1: FIC Algorithm Results (Local E-I Balance Tuning)
# =============================================================================

# A: S_e Before FIC
ax = axes["A"]
data = np.array(fic.pre_tuning.data[:, 0, :])
norm = Normalize(vmin=data.mean(0).min(), vmax=data.mean(0).max())
for i in range(data.shape[1]):
    ax.plot(data[:, i], color=cmap(norm(data.mean(0)[i])), lw=0.5, alpha=0.6)
ax.axhline(0.25, color=accent_gold, ls='--', lw=2, label='Target')
ax.set(xlabel="Time step", ylabel="S_e", title="A. FIC: Before Tuning")
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.legend(loc='upper right')

# B: S_e After FIC
ax = axes["B"]
data = np.array(fic.post_tuning.data[:, 0, :])
norm = Normalize(vmin=data.mean(0).min(), vmax=data.mean(0).max())
for i in range(data.shape[1]):
    ax.plot(data[:, i], color=cmap(norm(data.mean(0)[i])), lw=0.5, alpha=0.6)
ax.axhline(0.25, color=accent_gold, ls='--', lw=2, label='Target')
ax.set(xlabel="Time step", ylabel="S_e", title="B. FIC: After Tuning")
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.legend(loc='upper right')

# C: FIC Convergence (Mean S_e over iterations)
ax = axes["C"]
mean_Se = np.array(fic.history.mean_S_e)
ax.plot(mean_Se, lw=2, color=accent_blue, label='Mean S_e')
ax.axhline(0.25, color=accent_gold, ls='--', lw=2, label='Target')
ax.set(xlabel="FIC iteration", ylabel="Mean S_e", title="C. FIC: Convergence")
ax.legend(loc='upper right')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# D: J_i Distribution (fitted inhibitory weights)
ax = axes["D"]
J_i = np.array(fic.state.dynamics.J_i).flatten()
ax.bar(range(len(J_i)), J_i, alpha=0.7, color=accent_mid)
ax.set(xlabel="Region", ylabel="J_i", title="D. FIC: Inhibitory Weights")
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# =============================================================================
# ROW 2: FIC+EIB Combined + EIB-post-FIC Results
# =============================================================================

# E: FC Target (empirical)

fc_plot = np.copy(fc_target)

plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# F: FC after FIC+EIB

fc_plot = np.copy(fc_post_fic_eib)
np.fill_diagonal(fc_plot, np.nan)

ax.set(title=f"F. FIC+EIB FC (r={corr_fic_eib:.3f})")

# G: FC after EIB-post-FIC
ax = axes["G"]
fc_plot = np.copy(fc_post_eib)
np.fill_diagonal(fc_plot, np.nan)
im = ax.imshow(fc_plot, cmap='cividis', vmin=-0.2, vmax=0.9)
ax.set(title=f"G. EIB-post-FIC FC (r={corr_eib:.3f})")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# H: FIC+EIB Convergence (FC correlation)
ax = axes["H"]
ax2 = ax.twinx()
fc_corrs = np.array(fic_eib.history.fc_corr)

l2, = ax2.plot(fc_rmses, lw=2, color=accent_gold, label='FC RMSE')

ax2.set_ylabel("FC RMSE")
ax.legend(handles=[l1, l2], loc='center right')

# J: Gradient Loss Convergence
```
